title: Query tags for SQL warehouses are now generally available
body: Query tags are now generally available. You can apply custom key-value tags to SQL workloads for grouping, filtering, and cost attribution on Databricks SQL warehouses and Lakehouse//RT compute. Tags appear in `system.query.history` and on the **Query History** page of the Databricks UI. See [Query tags](/aws/en/sql/user/queries/query-tags).
